description: Benchmark tasks for comparing jcodemunch-mcp vs purecontext-mcp. Uses the PureContext repo itself as the test subject — pure TypeScript, both tools support it.

repos.description: PureContext MCP itself — TypeScript source, ~100 files. Path resolved at runtime from the repo root.

note: Single-keyword queries are used for Dimension 1 (token efficiency) so that both tools' substring-based keyword search can produce results. Multi-word natural-language queries are used in ground-truth.json for Dimension 2 (quality), where jcodemunch's word-level scoring vs PureContext keyword LIKE is a genuine differentiator.

tasks.description: Find symbol search logic (searchSymbols, ftsSearchSymbols, etc.).
Find dependency graph construction and traversal.
Find file watcher logic (startWatching, FileWatcher, etc.).
Find error classes and error handling (PureContextError, ParseError, etc.).
